This Privacy Policy explains how Systems Go ("the App", "we", "our") collects, uses, and protects your information.

1. Data We Collect
Systems Go is a remote desktop client. Connection profiles (host address, port, username, and saved credentials) are stored locally on your device only, encrypted using Android's secure storage. We do not upload your connection data, passwords, or session content to any server we control.

2. Permissions
The App may request network access to establish RDP/VNC/SSH connections, storage access for file transfer and screenshots, camera/microphone access only if you enable device-redirection features, and biometric access to unlock the App if you enable App Lock. Each permission is used solely to provide its corresponding feature.

3. Local Security
Saved passwords and PINs are encrypted on-device. Clearing app data or uninstalling the App permanently removes this information from your device.

4. Third-Party Services
The App does not currently include advertising or analytics SDKs. If ads, analytics, or subscription services are added in a future update, this policy will be updated in advance and you will be notified through an in-app changelog.

5. Data Sharing
We do not sell your personal data, and we do not share it with third parties beyond what is described above.

6. Your Rights
You may delete all locally stored data at any time from Settings → Data → Clear Data.

7. Contact
Questions about this policy can be sent to support@gotohex.dev or via Telegram @GoToHEX.

Note: this document is a starter template. Please review and adapt it to accurately reflect the App's real practices — especially before enabling ads, analytics, or subscriptions — prior to publishing.
